text: How many property sales were recorded in England and Wales in 2023?

gold_sql.clickhouse: SELECT count() AS sales FROM uk.uk_price_paid WHERE toYear(date) = 2023
gold_sql.snowflake: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales FROM ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID WHERE YEAR(date) = 2023

author: claude

text: What was the median price paid for a property in England and Wales in 2024?

gold_sql.clickhouse: SELECT quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(price) AS median_price FROM uk.uk_price_paid WHERE toYear(date) = 2024
gold_sql.snowflake: SELECT MEDIAN(price) AS median_price FROM ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID WHERE YEAR(date) = 2024

text: How many property sales were recorded in each month of 2024?

gold_sql.snowflake: SELECT MONTH(date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS sales FROM ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID WHERE YEAR(date) = 2024 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

text: Which 10 towns had the highest median price in 2024, among towns with at least 500 sales that year?

gold_sql.clickhouse: SELECT town, quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(price) AS median_price FROM uk.uk_price_paid WHERE toYear(date) = 2024 GROUP BY town HAVING count() >= 500 ORDER BY median_price DESC, town ASC LIMIT 10
gold_sql.snowflake: SELECT town, MEDIAN(price) AS median_price FROM ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID WHERE YEAR(date) = 2024 GROUP BY town HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500 ORDER BY median_price DESC, town ASC LIMIT 10

text: Rank the 3 property types (terraced, semi-detached, detached, flat and other) with the most sales in 2024.

gold_sql.clickhouse: SELECT type, count() AS sales FROM uk.uk_price_paid WHERE toYear(date) = 2024 GROUP BY type ORDER BY sales DESC, toString(type) ASC LIMIT 3
gold_sql.snowflake: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS sales FROM ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID WHERE YEAR(date) = 2024 GROUP BY type ORDER BY sales DESC, type ASC LIMIT 3

author: claude

text: Show the median price paid in England and Wales in 2023 and in 2024, and the percentage change from 2023 to 2024.

gold_sql.clickhouse: SELECT median_2023, median_2024, 100 * (toFloat64(median_2024) - median_2023) / median_2023 AS pct_change FROM (SELECT quantileExactInclusiveIf(0.5)(price, toYear(date) = 2023) AS median_2023, quantileExactInclusiveIf(0.5)(price, toYear(date) = 2024) AS median_2024 FROM uk.uk_price_paid WHERE toYear(date) IN (2023, 2024)) AS s
gold_sql.snowflake: SELECT median_2023, median_2024, 100 * (CAST(median_2024 AS DOUBLE) - median_2023) / median_2023 AS pct_change FROM (SELECT MEDIAN(IFF(YEAR(date) = 2023, price, NULL)) AS median_2023, MEDIAN(IFF(YEAR(date) = 2024, price, NULL)) AS median_2024 FROM ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID WHERE YEAR(date) IN (2023, 2024)) AS s

text: Show the number of property sales in 2022 and in 2023, and the percentage change from 2022 to 2023.

gold_sql.clickhouse: SELECT sales_2022, sales_2023, 100 * (toFloat64(sales_2023) - sales_2022) / sales_2022 AS pct_change FROM (SELECT countIf(toYear(date) = 2022) AS sales_2022, countIf(toYear(date) = 2023) AS sales_2023 FROM uk.uk_price_paid WHERE toYear(date) IN (2022, 2023)) AS s
gold_sql.snowflake: SELECT sales_2022, sales_2023, 100 * (CAST(sales_2023 AS DOUBLE) - sales_2022) / sales_2022 AS pct_change FROM (SELECT COUNT_IF(YEAR(date) = 2022) AS sales_2022, COUNT_IF(YEAR(date) = 2023) AS sales_2023 FROM ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID WHERE YEAR(date) IN (2022, 2023)) AS s
